description: This file defines the GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) controller for the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It manages GDPR-related pages and actions such as displaying GDPR information, handling GDPR requests like export and removal, and processing GDPR status updates. The file contains multiple methods for rendering GDPR views, validating requests, and updating GDPR status based on user actions.

classes.name: Gdpr
classes.description: Controller class handling GDPR information pages, user requests for GDPR actions, and GDPR status updates within the OpenCart platform.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the GDPR information page if GDPR info exists; otherwise returns not_found action.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Processes GDPR-related user requests such as export or remove, validating inputs and updating GDPR records.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Handles the GDPR action success page, confirming and updating GDPR request status, and displaying appropriate confirmation message.
